name: Analysarr
description: Self-hosted dashboard that brings together Emby or Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, your torrent client (qBittorrent, Deluge or Transmission) and optionally Seer and cross-seed, to show the health of every movie and series across your stack: duplicates, orphan torrents, missing hardlinks, single-tracker content, watch activity per user and who requested it. Clean up in a few clicks with a preview before anything is deleted. No configuration file needed: on first launch, create the administrator account and follow the setup wizard. Important: mount your data share exactly like in Emby/Jellyfin, your torrent client, Sonarr and Radarr (same host path, same container path), otherwise hardlinks cannot be detected.

paths.name: Data (media and downloads)
paths.description: Share holding your library and downloads. Use the SAME host path and the SAME container path as in Emby/Jellyfin, your torrent client, Sonarr and Radarr (e.g. TRaSH Guides layout: /mnt/user/data mounted on /data everywhere). Write access is only used when you delete media or repair hardlinks, always after a confirmation.

variables.name: Database path
variables.description: SQLite database location inside the container. Keep it inside the Appdata path so it survives updates.
